finalText:
Dana's new address is now on her unshipped order (O-1001), and her in-transit order (O-1002) is unchanged.

- **O-1001 (not shipped yet):** The shipping address changed from "12 Alder Lane, Bristol BS1 4TR, UK" to **"7 Quarry Rise, Sheffield S11 8XZ, UK"**. Both items on it (L1 P-KEY ×1 and L2 P-CAB ×2) are still waiting to ship. Nothing else on the order changed.
- **O-1002 (in transit):** I didn't touch it. Its single item (L1 P-MON) shipped on 2026-07-07, and our rules don't allow changing the address once an order has shipped. When I checked it again afterwards, the address was still "88 Old Mill Road, Bristol BS3 2QQ, UK" and the status, payment and refunds were exactly as before.

Before making the change, I checked each item on both orders. O-1001 had nothing shipped and O-1002 was fully shipped, which matches what you described.

1. **The two orders had different old addresses.** O-1001 was going to Alder Lane and O-1002 to Old Mill Road, both in Bristol. I replaced the Alder Lane address as asked. If Dana has also left Old Mill Road, the parcel in transit will arrive at an address she no longer lives at. That would have to be sorted out with the courier or as a return, because the order's address can't be changed.
2. **Her account address wasn't updated.** There's no way to edit a customer's saved address here, so it may still show an old address.
3. **The address went in as one line of text.** The plan expected separate fields (street, city, postcode, country), but the tool only accepts a single text field.
